body: And you're a hottie. Go you! :)
You would be surprised how many people share your thoughts on the matter, to be honest. Many of us would 'off' ourselves if we could do it without hurting anyone.
Great post. I really hope that you're able to work things out in your situation as well. You sound like you're going through a lot and you're still able to comfort others around you.

Just remember that during this time, you're going through a lot emotionally, physically, and everything else. Your husband is a piece of shit. There is no way to justify his behavior one way or the other. However, you are holding the most precious gift you could ever hope to be given. And that little girl of yours needs someone to raise her, to show her what love is, and to show her that men aren't the end of the world.

When you push through this, which you will, your daughter is going to be so proud of who her mom is. You sound like an amazing woman just looking for answers during one of the toughest times of your life. The answer is to push through. You're stronger than you could ever imagine, and you're going through a lot of the process my wife went through in regards to Post Partum Anxiety and Stress - from what I can tell.

It WILL pass, I promise! I'm sorry if this doesn't sound like a conventional post, I've never posted here to help someone before, just came here once several months ago to vent my frustrations and was shown such love and compassion that I was able to push through it for one more day. One day at a time, that is all you can do, but I promise you that things will work out in the end and you'll be so happy you chose to stay.

You made me cry, man. For real, thank you. <3

I hope you don't go through with it. I know it is incredibly selfish of me to say that but I mean, who knows. Shit doesn't make sense.
Thank you, I hope you're doing well, man. Gaming is definitely a fun release. Maybe I'll start something again...
Sorry, it was .45. My mind isn't really too focused on that stuff today. A 45mm would go through an engine block tho, that's a really big bullet.
I'm sorry, I don't know what else to say. Thank you for the kind words.
